scientific_integrity: Original source is credited for the model and the explicitly posed question. All finite computations are distinguished from the analytic proof; no external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The conclusion concerns the deterministic Cao–Gong mean-field ODE and one-sided initial distributions with positive mass strictly on that side. It does not classify mixed-sign basins, quantify uniform relaxation rates, or yield finite-population fixation probabilities. Priority remains subject to independent historical assessment.
title: One-sided initial opinions select extreme consensus in the incremental voter mean-field model
